fact: On 28 April 2023 the sectoral ministers presented a global budget of 1,399,971,262,823.93 GNF drawn up by the Ministry of Territorial Administration and Decentralisation for the RAVEC, with a specification, timetable and provisional budget, under which the 2,535 principal and secondary civil status centres are to be given computers and tablets.
title: Transition : le coût du RAVEC chiffré à plus de mille milliards GNF
